verdict.rationale: turbopuffer's docs state that native embedding is generally available. They also say turbopuffer embeds your text on both writes and queries, so you don't integrate an embedding provider at all. That directly covers in-database embedding at ingest and query time without a separate pipeline. Missing for 10: documentation of which embedding models are available or how to configure them (dimensions, provider choice, bring-your-own-model), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the native embedding feature.
